Section.Name: 911 Food Poisoning
Section.Content:
Call 911
Call 911 if immediate medical attention is needed.

You can report people getting food poisoning. Food poisoning occurs when food eaten by a person gives them a physical illness with the following symptoms:

  • Vomiting
  • Diarrhea
  • Abdominal cramps

You can report food poisoning caused by eating food made by any commercial establishment or from eating at parties, weddings, banquets, or other gatherings.

Section.Name: 1 or 2 People Sick
Section.Content:
When reporting cases of food poisoning, you should provide the number of people who became sick and the type of food you think caused the illness.

What Happens Next

Though anonymous reports are accepted, if you can provide at least a daytime phone number, it will help the City with any follow-up questions as your report is investigated. While all reports are investigated, not every food establishment will be inspected prior to its next scheduled inspection.

ContentAction.Name: Food Poisoning of 1 or 2 People
ContentAction.Agency: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
